# Baseline for parser/corpus_test.go's TestSVTestsCorpusMatchesBaseline.
#
# One "path expected-count # reason" line per vendored file that produces a
# nonzero preprocessor+parser error count. Every entry is deliberate: either
# an intentional sv-tests negative test (:should_fail_because:), or a
# genuinely out-of-scope construct for a declaration-grade parser (see
# the design note in ../parser/corpus_test.go). Any file NOT listed here
# is expected to produce zero errors -- a regression there fails the test
# the same as a baseline mismatch does.
#
# Updating this file is a deliberate act, not a formality: a new entry
# should come with a real reason, and a removed entry should mean a genuine
# fix landed (with its own commit, its own tests) -- never a silent baseline
# regeneration.

# --- Intentional sv-tests negative tests (:should_fail_because:) ---
chapter-22/22.11--pragma-invalid.sv 1 # should_fail_because: The pragma specification is identified by the pragma_name, which follows the `pragma directive.
chapter-22/22.12--line-illegal-1.sv 1 # should_fail_because: The level parameter shall be 0, 1, or 2
chapter-22/22.12--line-illegal-2.sv 1 # should_fail_because: The filename parameter shall be a string literal
chapter-22/22.12--line-illegal-3.sv 1 # should_fail_because: The number parameter shall be a positive integer that specifies the new line number
chapter-22/22.12--line-illegal-4.sv 1 # should_fail_because: The level parameter shall be 0, 1, or 2
chapter-22/22.12--line-illegal-5.sv 1 # should_fail_because: Missing filename
chapter-22/22.3--resetall_illegal.sv 1 # should_fail_because: It shall be illegal for the `resetall directive to be specified within a design element.
chapter-22/22.5.1--define-expansion_12.sv 1 # should_fail_because: fewer actual than formal macro args with no default for the rest
chapter-22/22.5.1--define-expansion_18.sv 2 # should_fail_because: function-like macro invoked without parentheses
chapter-22/22.5.1--define-expansion_21.sv 5 # should_fail_because: macro text split across string literals; the unterminated string corrupts the initial statement's own token stream too, reported as "expected ';' before \"endmodule\"" -- was 4 while the statement skip ran to EOF (taking endmodule with it, so the container reported its own unexpected-EOF as well); now 5 with the two body errors the statement parser reports at the corrupted line
chapter-22/22.5.1--define-expansion_23.sv 1 # should_fail_because: All compiler directives shall be considered predefined macro names; it shall be illegal to redefine a compiler directive as a macro name.
chapter-22/22.5.1--define-expansion_6.sv 1 # should_fail_because: fewer actual than formal macro args with no default for the rest
chapter-22/22.5.1--define-expansion_7.sv 1 # should_fail_because: function-like macro invoked without parentheses
chapter-22/22.5.1--define-expansion_8.sv 1 # should_fail_because: more actual than formal macro args -- newly detected; svparse used to drop the surplus silently, so this file sat outside the baseline entirely
chapter-22/22.7--timescale-basic-3.sv 1 # should_fail_because: The integers in `timescale arguments specify an order of magnitude for the size of the value; the valid integers are 1, 10, and 100
chapter-22/22.7--timescale-basic-4.sv 1 # should_fail_because: The time_precision argument shall be at least as precise as the time_unit argument; it cannot specify a longerunit of time than time_unit.
chapter-22/22.9--unconnected_drive-invalid-1.sv 1 # should_fail_because: The directive `unconnected_drive takes one of two arguments - pull1 or pull0.
chapter-22/22.9--unconnected_drive-invalid-2.sv 1 # should_fail_because: The directive `unconnected_drive takes one of two arguments - pull1 or pull0
chapter-22/22.9--unconnected_drive-invalid-3.sv 1 # should_fail_because: use a strength keyword with `nounconnected_drive macro
chapter-5/5.6--wrong-identifiers.sv 2 # should_fail_because: identifiers starting with a digit or $
chapter-5/5.7.1--integers-unsized-illegal.sv 1 # should_fail_because: hexadecimal format requires 'h; reported from the statement body (feature/expr-diagnostics)
chapter-5/5.7.2-real-constants-illegal.sv 5 # should_fail_because: real literals need a digit on each side of the point; reported from the statement body (feature/expr-diagnostics)
chapter-8/8.26.4--illegal_forward_def_implements.sv 3 # should_fail_because: illegal forward-typedef interface-class implements

# --- Out of scope: preprocessor macro operators this preprocessor doesn't implement ---

# --- Out of scope: `include forms this preprocessor doesn't resolve ---
chapter-5/5.6.4--compiler-directives-include.sv 1 # `include "/dev/null" -- absolute path outside the vendored corpus, platform-specific, not resolved by this harness's relative resolver

# --- Out of scope: `begin_keywords/`end_keywords dynamic keyword-set switching (LRM 22.11) ---

# --- Out of scope: this harness has no :defines: metadata support ---
chapter-5/5.6.4--compiler-directives-preprocessor-macro_0.sv 2 # requires :defines: TEST_VAR (an external +define+, not something in the source itself); without it the file's own `else branch is (intentionally) invalid placeholder text
